items.title: Titanic
items.explain: 🚢🧊 the ship hits the iceberg, 💔 the doomed love story, 🎻 the band that kept playing as it sank.

items.title: The Hunger Games
items.explain: 🏹 Katniss's weapon, 🕊️ the mockingjay symbol, 🔥 'the girl on fire', 👧 a young tribute fighting to survive.

items.title: The Hobbit
items.explain: 🧙‍♂️ Gandalf, ⛰️ the Lonely Mountain, 🐉💰 Smaug guarding his hoard of treasure inside it.

items.title: The Matrix
items.explain: 🔴🔵💊 the red pill / blue pill choice, 🕶️ Neo's signature look, 0️⃣1️⃣ the simulated, code-built reality underneath.

items.title: The Wizard of Oz
items.explain: 🌪️ the tornado that carries Dorothy to Oz, 🦁 the Cowardly Lion seeking courage, 🤖 the Tin Man seeking a heart, 👠 the ruby slippers that bring her home, 🐕 Toto her loyal dog.

items.title: Jaws
items.explain: 🦈 the great white shark terrorizing the coast, 🌊 the ocean attack, 🚤 the boat hunting it down, 🏖️ the beach town too scared to swim.

items.title: Downton Abbey
items.explain: 🏰 the grand English estate, 🔔 the servants' call-bell system, 🎩 the aristocratic Crawley family, 🍽️ the elaborate upstairs dinners.

items.title: Frankenstein
items.explain: ⚡ the lightning that brings the creature to life, 🧟 the monster himself, 🔬 Victor's lab experiments, 🧵 the stitched-together body, 🔥 the torch-wielding mob that hunts him, 🏔️ the Arctic chase that ends the story.

items.title: Frozen
items.explain: ❄️ the literal frozen ice powers, 👸 princess Elsa, ⛄ Olaf the snowman.

items.title: The Great British Bake Off
items.explain: 🎪 the famous marquee tent, 🎂🧁 the bakes themselves, 👩‍🍳 the home bakers competing each week, ⏱️ racing against the clock.

items.title: Peter Pan
items.explain: 🧚 Tinker Bell, ⏳ never growing old in Neverland, 🏴‍☠️ Captain Hook's pirates, 🌟 'second star to the right and straight on till morning,' 🪟 the nursery window they fly out of.

items.title: The Godfather
items.explain: 🍊 the oranges that keep appearing right before someone dies, 🤐 the mafia code of silence, 👔 the family business built on power, 🚬 the old-world cigar-smoking dons, 🕯️ the baptism intercut with murders, 🍷 the long family dinner table.

items.title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
items.explain: 🍎 the poisoned apple, 🪞 the magic mirror ('mirror mirror'), ⛏️ the Seven Dwarfs off to work.

items.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
items.explain: 🍫 the chocolate itself, 🎫 the golden ticket that gets you in, 👦 Charlie, 🏭 Willy Wonka's mysterious factory.

items.title: Ghostbusters
items.explain: 👻 the ghosts terrorizing the city, 🧪 the homemade proton-pack science, 🔋 the packs' power cells, 🚕 the New York setting, 🏢 their firehouse headquarters.

items.title: Moby Dick
items.explain: 🚢 the long whaling voyage, 🔱 the harpoon hunt, ⚪ the whale's unnatural white colour at the heart of the obsession, 😤 Captain Ahab's all-consuming revenge, 🌊 the endless open sea, ⚓ a voyage that never comes home.

items.title: Aladdin
items.explain: 🧞 the genie granted from the lamp, 🪔 the magic lamp itself, 🐒 Abu, Aladdin's mischievous monkey sidekick.

items.title: Doctor Who
items.explain: 🕰️ constant time travel, 🌀 the swirling time vortex, 🤖 the robotic alien villains, 🧣 the Doctor's iconic long scarf, 🔵 the blue police box that's really a time machine.

items.title: Dracula
items.explain: 🧛 Count Dracula himself, 🦇 his bat form, 🩸 the blood he feeds on, 🏰 his Transylvanian castle, ⚰️ the coffin he rests in by day, 🌙 the night he only ever moves by.

items.title: Casablanca
items.explain: ✈️ the fateful plane departure at the airport, 🎹 'As Time Goes By' played on the piano, 💔 the doomed wartime romance, 🥂 Rick's Café Américain, 🌍 the WWII refugee crossroads setting, 🚬 the smoky noir atmosphere, 🛂 the letters of transit everyone's desperate for.

items.title: Shrek
items.explain: 🧌 Shrek the ogre, 🐴 Donkey his talking sidekick, 🧅 his famous "ogres are like onions" line.

items.title: A Christmas Carol
items.explain: 👻 the three ghosts who visit Scrooge, ⛓️ Marley's chains, 🎄 the Christmas setting itself, 💰 Scrooge's miserly obsession with money before his change of heart.

items.title: Fawlty Towers
items.explain: 🏨 the chaotic small hotel, 😤 Basil Fawlty's constant simmering rage, 🔔 the front desk where disasters unfold, 🚗 his infamous breakdown beating his car with a branch, 🧔 Basil's own exasperated moustache, 🍽️ the dining-room chaos every episode circles back to.

items.title: Wuthering Heights
items.explain: 🌫️ the wild, windswept Yorkshire moors, 🏚️ the isolated Wuthering Heights house, 💔 Heathcliff and Cathy's destructive, doomed love, 👻 Cathy's ghost said to haunt the moors, 🌾 the untamed moorland setting, ⛈️ the stormy gothic atmosphere, 🐕 the dogs recurring throughout the story.

items.title: Matilda
items.explain: 📚 Matilda's love of books, 🧠 her genius mind, ✋ her telekinetic powers.

items.title: Die Hard
items.explain: 🏢 the Nakatomi Plaza skyscraper under siege, 💥 the explosive action, 🦶 John McClane fighting barefoot, 🎄 the Christmas Eve setting.

items.title: The Shining
items.explain: 🏨 the isolated Overlook Hotel, ❄️ snowed in for the winter, 🪓 Jack's iconic axe, 👦 Danny and his psychic "shining" visions, 🌀 the hedge maze chase at the climax, 🩸 the blood-flooded elevator image burned into film history.

items.title: Great Expectations
items.explain: 👰 the jilted Miss Havisham, frozen in her wedding dress, 🕰️ every clock in her house stopped at the moment she was jilted, 🎂 her rotting wedding cake left untouched for decades, 🏚️ the decaying Satis House, ⛓️ Pip's secret connection to the escaped convict Magwitch, 💍 the wedding that never happened, 🕯️ the dim, candlelit gloom she lives in.

items.title: The Little Mermaid
items.explain: 🧜‍♀️ Ariel the mermaid, 🐚 her underwater world, 🎤 the voice she trades away to Ursula.

items.title: Charlotte's Web
items.explain: 🕷️ Charlotte the spider, 🕸️ her web where she weaves messages, 🐷 Wilbur the pig she's trying to save, 🚜 the farm they both live on.

items.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
items.explain: 🤠 Indiana Jones's adventurer look, 🐍 his fear of snakes, 🗺️ the hunt across ancient ruins, 📦 the mysterious wooden crate the Ark is sealed in, 😱 the horrifying finale when it's finally opened, 🔥 the face-melting climax.

items.title: M*A*S*H
items.explain: 🚁 the helicopters bringing in wounded soldiers, ⛺ the army field hospital tents, 🩺 the doctors and medics at work, 😂 the dark comedy woven through the chaos, 🔫 the Korean War backdrop the whole show is set against, 🍸 the Swamp tent's off-duty drinking, 📢 the camp's constant loudspeaker announcements.

items.title: Sherlock Holmes
items.explain: 🕵️ the detective himself, 🔍 his magnifying glass, 🎻 his violin.

items.title: The Da Vinci Code
items.explain: 🖼️ the Mona Lisa at the heart of the mystery, 🏛️ the Louvre, 🔢 the cipher-cracking, 🗝️ the cryptex, ⛪ the church conspiracy.

items.title: Dad's Army
items.explain: 🪖 the Home Guard helmets, 👴 the older-than-usual soldiers, ⚔️ their under-equipped weaponry, 🚨 constant invasion-panic, 🏖️ the seaside town of Walmington-on-Sea.

items.title: Brave New World
items.explain: 🧪 lab-engineered humans, 👶 test-tube babies, 💊 the soma drug, 🏭 the hatchery, 🎭 enforced conformity, 👑 the Alpha/caste hierarchy, 🌎 the dystopian world order.

items.title: Chicken Run
items.explain: 🐔 the chickens, 🏃 their escape attempt, 🚧 the fenced-in farm they're trapped on, ✈️ their homemade escape flight, 🥧 the pie machine threatening them.

items.title: Interview with the Vampire
items.explain: 🧛 the vampire, 🩸 his bloodlust, 🎙️ the framing device of the taped interview, 🕯️ the gothic candlelit setting, 🌙 his nocturnal existence.

items.title: National Treasure
items.explain: 📜 the Declaration of Independence, 🗺️ the hidden treasure map, 💰 the treasure itself, 🕵️ the amateur-historian hero, 🦅 the American iconography, 🔑 the hidden clues.

items.title: Poirot
items.explain: 🥸 his famous moustache, 🥚 his egg-shaped head, 🧠 his "little grey cells", ⏰ his obsessive precision.

items.title: Mr. Bean
items.explain: 🧸 his teddy bear, 🚗 his little car, 🤐 his near-wordless comedy, 🫘 Bean himself.

items.title: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
items.explain: 🎫 the golden ticket, 🍫 the chocolate itself, 🏭 the factory, 🎩 Wonka's top hat.

items.title: Jurassic World
items.explain: 🦖 the dinosaurs, 🧬 their cloned DNA, 🌎 the island park's world of creatures, 🚪 the gates, 🚧 the containment breaking down.

items.title: The BFG
items.explain: 👂 his giant ears (he hears everything), 💭 the dreams he collects, 🫙 the jars he keeps them in, 😊 his gentle nature, ✨ the dream-magic itself.
